en: We'll be out of here just as soon as I get this wagon fixed. . . .
Don't make me angry! You wouldn't like me when I'm angry!
This should ease the pain.
I have lost my Zandalar Illusionist's Robe and need a new one, Al'tabim.
Upperdeck Promotion - Landro Default

I have discovered a use for the carapace of the crypt fiend and its various body parts. I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas.
Your skills are coming along nicely. Soon you'll be running a leather shop of your own. I'll be glad for the help, $n. My hands are only so fast, you know? There's so much work to do!
Good... good, A-Me. A-Me good. Home. Find home.
Do you think you've won? So easily? The legion has only just begun its march. The armies of C'Thun will raze this world.
Hear me, denizens of the Crater!  I come to burn this land of its impurity!
By the strength of the earth, the power of storms, and...
%s is littered with broken bones and cracker crumbs.
What battleground you want?
Hmmm, that good idea.  Maybe we head there to get some stitches replaced?  Him sew good.  You find Josef Gregorian on inner circle of Magic Quarter.

It's true, even stranglekelp can be quite useful in building up what we need for the upcoming war at Ahn'Qiraj! It has so many uses, like making ice cream for hot days under the Silithus sun, as a salve for the effects of some icky plants, breathing underwater, hardening the skin, making you quick, regaining magic power; so many things I can't think of them all! Did I mention making ice cream?$B$BAnywhoodles, I've got about $2047w here, and I need a total of $2048w!
What was that? Did you leave that flare lit?!

A Sulfuron ingot?!??! Impossible! I must have it! I must! I must!$B$B$R, I am authorized to make you a grand deal for that ingot. Perhaps you would be interested to know the secrets of the Hand of Ragnaros? Sulfuras, idiot! The legendary hammer of the Firelord.
You look in The Apothecarium.  That where Doctor Herbert Halsey and Doctor Marsh practice.

He took the unforged rune covered breastplate, used in the making of the demon forged breastplate and ran away without making payment. A fool, I am not, however... the unforged chest piece is useless without knowledge or the recipe to apply said knowledge.$B$BI wonder... does he sit safely in his city of Blackrock Spire and attempt to create the item from the raw material? I know he dare not leave!
Al'tabim, my Zandalar Confessor's Wraps have gone missing. Can you replace them?
Mograine?
You've made a good start, but you still have a great deal to learn, $n.
Hmm, well, I can see that you have a little skill at making potions. Whether you're worthy to be my student remains to be seen, however. I have a job for you. Impress me.
Welcome to the Cenarion Circle, $c.  How may I assist you?
Foolish $C!  You are no match for the minions of Ragnaros!
I am here!  Come face me, if you dare!
Ye need some training?  Well, Azar Stronghammer is always up for showing the younger paladins a thing or two.  Why don't ye go see him in the Thunderbrew Distillery.
I'll deliver you, weak $C, to the afterlife!
Very few seek me out... What may I do for you?
Please.
Some adventurers think enchanting doesn't work. I find that when I challenge them to battle they change their tune!
What are those crates for?
Possessed by what?
Blackrock Spire
Tell me again about graveyards...
The League of Arathor has sworn to retake Arathi for humans of Stromgarde and the Alliance.  It is a battle hard fought, but a battle worth fighting.
Falthir, I need assistance in replacing a piece of my Predator's Armor.
DUMMY SPELL TEST MESSAGE

Well, from what I've gathered while waiting to be eaten by these yokels... it might not be necessary to kill every ogre you find here.$B$BThe ogres were going on and on the other day about how King Gordok came to power; specifically, he killed the previous king and took his place.  Well, the king's henchmen - those that Gordok spared - immediately swore fealty to the new king.$B$BWho knows - the ogre you save could very well be your own... figuratively speaking, of course!
Defenders of Darrowshire!  Rally!  We must prevail!

How I yearn to join you in glorious battle, but instead I am stuck here on duty. Go to the Hall of the Brave in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor and speak to Kartra Bloodsnarl. She will help you get to Alterac Valley. Make us proud $n!
%s begins to summon wraiths out of the freezing cold air!
Not again...
%s happily follows $n as $ghis:her; new seedling.
